# 10X

> 10X helps Malaysian service businesses capture enquiries, respond faster, book appointments and keep follow-up moving. Core idea: your leads don't disappear, they leak. 10X exists to reduce those leaks.

- Website: https://tenx.my
- Company: BTB SOLUTIONS Sdn Bhd (Registration 202503175924), Malaysia
- Email: admin@tenx.my
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12-372 8392
- Official call to action: Get Your Free Lead Leakage Audit (free 15-minute review, no obligation) at https://tenx.my/#audit

## Who it is for

- Property agents and teams
- Aesthetic clinics
- Dental clinics
- Home service businesses (aircon, cleaning, plumbing, repair)

## Operating model

CAPTURE → RESPOND → QUALIFY → BOOK → FOLLOW UP → REACTIVATE → CLOSE

## Available now

- Lead capture and forms
- Contact management
- Opportunities and pipelines
- Calendars and booking pages
- Websites and funnels
- Staff management and lead ownership
- Private multi-tenant workspaces

## Coming to 10X (not generally available yet)

- AI employee: rollout in progress
- WhatsApp message sending: integration-dependent
- Outbound email sequences: rollout in progress
- Payments and payment reminders: coming soon
- Advanced reporting: coming soon

## Pricing (Malaysian ringgit, per month)

Founding prices apply to the first 10 customers. WhatsApp costs are passed through at cost.

- Launch: RM427/month founding (normally RM599). Setup RM300. For teams that need a simple system for leads and follow-up.
- Growth: RM799/month founding (normally RM1,199). Setup RM500. For teams ready to automate more of the customer journey.
- Scale: from RM1,499/month founding (normally from RM1,999). Setup from RM1,000. For businesses requiring deeper workflows and custom implementation.

## Terminology

- Lead leakage: an enquiry lost because nobody replied, followed up, owned it, booked it, or could see what happened.
- Lead Leakage Audit: a free 15-minute review of how enquiries move through a business and where they break down.
- AI employee: a planned 10X assistant for repetitive conversations, qualification and follow-up, working inside rules and approvals set by the business. It supports teams and does not replace clinical or professional judgment.

## Notes for accuracy

- Product demos on the website use illustrative data.
- 10X does not claim certifications, guaranteed results or verified performance statistics.
